History and Development of Our Business
paragraphs: Our company is a Canadian corporation incorporated under the laws of British Columbia. Our company was established by the partnership to be an alternative investment vehicle for investors who prefer owning securities through a corporate structure. We became a separately-traded public company upon completion of the special distribution in July 2020, and the Arrangement was completed in December 2024. While our operations are primarily located in Brazil, Colombia, the United States, and Europe, shareholders will, on economic terms, have exposure to all regions BEP operates in as a result of the exchange feature attaching to the BEPC exchangeable shares.

Each BEPC exchangeable share has been structured with the intention of providing an economic return equivalent to one BEP unit (subject to adjustment to reflect certain capital events), including identical dividends on a per share basis as are paid on each BEP unit, and is exchangeable at the option of the holder for one BEP unit (subject to adjustment to reflect certain capital events) or its cash equivalent (the form of payment to be determined at the election of our company), as more fully described in this Form 20-F. BEP may elect to satisfy its exchange obligation by acquiring such tendered BEPC exchangeable shares for an equivalent number of BEP units (subject to adjustment to reflect certain capital events) or its cash equivalent (the form of payment to be determined at the election of our group). See Item 10.B "Memorandum and Articles of Association—BEPC Exchangeable Shares—Adjustments to Reflect Certain Capital Events". Our company and the partnership currently intend to satisfy any exchange requests on the BEPC exchangeable shares through the delivery of BEP units rather than cash. We therefore expect that the market price of BEPC exchangeable shares will be impacted by the market price of the BEP units and the combined business performance of our group as a whole. However, there are certain material differences between the rights of holders of BEPC exchangeable shares and holders of the BEP units under the governing documents of our company and the partnership and applicable law, such as the right of holders of BEPC exchangeable shares to request an exchange of their BEPC exchangeable shares for an equivalent number of BEP units or its cash equivalent (the form of payment to be determined at the election of our company) and the redemption right of our company. These material differences are described in the section entitled Item 10.B "Memorandum and Articles of Association—Comparison of Rights of Holders of BEPC Exchangeable Shares and BEP Units".

Further, BEPC exchangeable shares are held by Brookfield Wealth Solutions and public shareholders and BEPC class B shares are held by the partnership. Dividends on each BEPC exchangeable share are expected to continue to be declared and paid at the same time and in the same amount per share as distributions on each BEP unit. The partnership's ownership of BEPC class B shares entitle it to receive dividends as and when declared by our board of directors. The holders of the BEPC exchangeable shares are entitled to one vote for each BEPC exchangeable share held at all meetings of our company's shareholders, except for meetings at which only holders of another specified class or series of shares of our company are entitled to vote separately as a class or series. The holders of the BEPC class B shares will be entitled to cast, in the aggregate, a number of votes equal to three times the number of votes attached to the BEPC exchangeable shares. Except as otherwise expressly provided in the BEPC articles or as required by law, the holders of BEPC exchangeable shares and BEPC class B shares will vote together and not as separate classes. See Item 10.B "Memorandum and Articles of Association—BEPC Exchangeable Shares".
Our company's current operations consist of approximately 13,396 MW of installed hydroelectric, wind, solar, storage and ancillary capacity across Brazil, Colombia, North America and Europe.

As a controlled subsidiary of the partnership, an integral part of our strategy is to participate along with institutional investors in Brookfield-sponsored funds, consortia, joint ventures and other arrangements, that target acquisitions that suit our company's profile. Across our group's business, our group leverages its extensive operating experience to maintain and enhance the value of assets, grow cash flows on an annual basis and cultivate positive relations with local stakeholders. Our group also makes investments in sustainable solutions businesses, which are generally comprised of emerging transition asset classes where our group's initial investment positions it for potential future large-scale decarbonization investments.

Brookfield Renewable targets a total return of 12% to 15% per annum on the renewable assets that they own, measured over the long term. Our group intends to generate this return from the in-place cash flows from our operations plus growth through investments in upgrades and expansions of our asset base, as well as acquisitions. The partnership determines its distributions based primarily on an assessment of our operating performance. Our group uses FFO to assess operating performance and can be used on a per unit basis as a proxy for future distribution growth over the long-term.

We are subject to the informational requirements of the Exchange Act. In accordance with these requirements, we file reports and other information as a foreign private issuer with the SEC. The SEC maintains an Internet site that contains reports, proxy and information statements, and other information relating to our company. The site is located at http://www.sec.gov. Similar information can also be found on our website at https://bep.brookfield.com/bepc. In addition to carefully considering the disclosure made in this document, shareholders are strongly encouraged to carefully review the partnership's periodic reporting. The partnership is required to file reports, including annual reports on Form 20-F, and other information with the SEC. The partnership's SEC filings are available to the public from the SEC's website noted above. Copies of documents that have been filed with the Canadian securities authorities can be obtained at www.sedarplus.ca. Information about the partnership, including its SEC filings, is also available on its website at https://bep.brookfield.com. The information found on, or accessible through, our or the partnership's website does not form part of this annual report on Form 20-F. See also Item 10.H "Documents on Display".

On July 30, 2020, the partnership completed the special distribution of BEPC exchangeable shares to holders of BEP units of record on July 27, 2020. Prior to completing the special distribution, our company acquired the Business (as defined herein) from certain of the partnership's subsidiaries (excluding a 10% interest in certain Brazilian and Colombian operations, which continue to be held by the partnership). The partnership directly and indirectly controlled the Business prior to the special distribution and will continue to control the Business subsequent to the special distribution through its interests in our company. See Item 5.A "Operating Results—Continuity of Interest".

On July 31, 2020, Brookfield Renewable completed the TerraForm Power acquisition pursuant to which Brookfield Renewable acquired all of the public TerraForm Power shares, representing a 38% interest in TerraForm Power. Pursuant to the TerraForm Power acquisition, each holder of public TerraForm Power shares received 0.47625 of a BEPC exchangeable share or of a BEP unit for each public TerraForm Power share held by such holder. The TerraForm Power acquisition was completed in exchange for 55,552,862 BEPC exchangeable shares and 6,051,704 BEP units, on a post-split basis.

Simultaneously with the completion of the TerraForm Power acquisition, our company entered into voting agreements with the partnership and certain indirect subsidiaries of Brookfield to transfer the power to vote their respective shares held in TerraForm Power to our company. As a result, our company controls and consolidates TerraForm Power. The transfer of control of TerraForm Power to our company is considered to be a transaction between entities under common control and was valued based on Brookfield's carrying value in TerraForm Power. The results of TerraForm Power that was not owned by our company will be presented as non-controlling interests to our company retrospectively to October 17, 2017, corresponding to all historical periods that TerraForm Power was under common control.

On December 24, 2024, BEPC completed a reorganization through a court approved plan of arrangement under the BCBCA (the "Arrangement") pursuant to which (i) holders of Old BRHC's exchangeable shares, other than Brookfield, received BEPC exchangeable shares for their exchangeable shares of Old BRHC on a one-for-one basis; (ii) Brookfield exchanged their class A exchangeable subordinate voting shares of Old BRHC for class A.2 exchangeable shares on a one-for-one basis; (iii) the exchangeable shares of Old BRHC were delisted; and (iv) BEPC exchangeable shares were listed on the NYSE and the TSX. The purpose of the Arrangement was to allow Brookfield Renewable to maintain the benefits of its business structure, while addressing proposed amendments to the Income Tax Act (Canada) that were expected to result in additional costs to BEPC if no action was taken.

In March 2025, Brookfield Renewable issued C$450 million of Series 19 medium-term notes (green bonds) at a fixed rate of 4.542%. The Series 19 medium-term notes are fully and unconditionally guaranteed by BEP and certain of its subsidiaries.

In April 2025, Brookfield Renewable, together with institutional partners, completed the sale of a 1,004 MW portfolio of wind and solar assets in India in separate tranches for proceeds of approximately $188 million ($52 million net to Brookfield Renewable).

In June 2025, Brookfield Renewable issued C$250 million of fixed-to-fixed reset rate green subordinated hybrid notes at an initial fixed rate of 5.373%. The hybrid notes are fully and unconditionally guaranteed by BEP and certain of its subsidiaries.

BEPC is a Canadian corporation incorporated on October 3, 2024 under the laws of British Columbia. Our company was established by Brookfield Renewable to be an alternative investment vehicle for investors who prefer owning securities through a corporate structure. While our operations are primarily located in the United States, Brazil, Colombia, and Europe, shareholders will, on economic terms, have exposure to all regions BEP operates in as a result of the exchange feature attaching to the Class A exchangeable subordinate voting shares ("BEPC exchangeable shares"), whereby BEPC will have the option to meet an exchange request by delivering cash or non-voting limited partnership units of BEP ("LP units").

The BEPC exchangeable shares of our company are structured with the intention of being economically equivalent to the LP units. We believe economic equivalence is achieved through identical dividends and distributions on the BEPC exchangeable shares and the LP units and each BEPC exchangeable share being exchangeable at the option of the holder for one LP unit at any time. Given the economic equivalence, we expect that the market price of the BEPC exchangeable shares will be significantly impacted by the market price of the LP units and the combined business performance of our company and Brookfield Renewable as a whole. In addition to carefully considering the disclosure made in this document, shareholders are strongly encouraged to carefully review the partnership's periodic reporting. The partnership is required to file reports, including annual reports on Form 20-F, and other information with the United States Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC"). The partnership's SEC filings are available to the public from the SEC's website at https://www.sec.gov. Copies of documents that have been filed with the Canadian securities authorities can be obtained at https://www.sedarplus.ca. Information about the partnership, including its SEC filings, is also available on its website at https://bep.brookfield.com. The information found on, or accessible through https://bep.brookfield.com is not incorporated into and does not form a part of this MD&A.

Our company, Brookfield Renewable Holdings Corporation ("BRHC"), our subsidiaries and Brookfield Renewable, (together our "Group"), target a total return of 12% to 15% per annum on the renewable assets that we own, measured over the long-term. Our group intends to generate this return from cash flows from our operations plus growth through investments in upgrades and expansions of our asset base, as well as acquisitions and capital recycling initiatives. Brookfield Renewable determines its distributions based primarily on an assessment of its operating performance. Our group uses Funds From Operations ("FFO") to assess operating performance which can be used on a per unit basis as a proxy for future distribution growth over the long-term. For further details, see the "Performance Disclosures" section of this MD&A.

On December 24, 2024, the partnership, BRHC, and the company completed an arrangement (the "Arrangement"), pursuant to which 1505127 B.C. Ltd. (which was renamed Brookfield Renewable Corporation) became the "successor issuer" (as defined in NI 44-101) to the former BEPC, which was renamed Brookfield Renewable Holdings Corporation and BRHC's class A exchangeable subordinate voting shares were delisted. The purpose of the Arrangement was to allow BEPC to maintain the benefits of its business structure, while addressing proposed amendments to the Income Tax Act (Canada) that were expected to result in additional costs to the company if no action was taken. In connection with the Arrangement, among other things, (i) holders of class A exchangeable subordinate voting shares of BRHC, other than Brookfield, received BEPC exchangeable shares in exchange for their class A exchangeable subordinate voting shares of BRHC on a one-for-one basis; (ii) Brookfield exchanged their class A exchangeable subordinate voting shares of BRHC for class A.2 exchangeable shares on a one-for-one basis; (iii) the class A exchangeable subordinate voting shares of BRHC were delisted; (iv) the exchangeable shares of BEPC were listed on the NYSE and the TSX; (v) the partnership transferred 55 class B shares of BRHC to BEPC in exchange for 55 class B shares of BEPC; and (vi) 43,605 class B shares of BEPC were issued to the partnership in exchange for $1 million. The class A.2 exchangeable shares are exchangeable by Brookfield into BEPC exchangeable shares (subject to an ownership cap that limits the exchange by Brookfield of

class A.2 exchangeable shares such that exchanges by Brookfield may not result in Brookfield owning 9.5% or more of the aggregate fair market value of all issued and outstanding shares of BEPC) or LP units on a one-for-one basis.

paragraphs: 本公司為加拿大公司，依據不列顛哥倫比亞省法律設立。本公司由合夥關係設立，作為投資者偏好透過公司結構擁有證券之替代投資工具。我們於2020年7月完成特別分紅後成為獨立交易上市公司，並於2024年12月完成合併程序。雖然本公司之營運主要位於巴西、哥倫比亞、美國及歐洲，但股東在經濟層面將因BEP所經營地區之交換特性而擁有所有地區之曝險。

每張BEPC交換權證已結構設計為提供與一張BEP單位相同之經濟回報（需根據特定資本事件進行調整），包括與每張BEP單位相同之每股股息，且持有人可選擇將其交換為一張BEP單位（需根據特定資本事件進行調整）或其現金等值（付款形式由本公司選擇決定），如本Form 20-F中更詳細說明。BEP可選擇以取得所投遞之BEPC交換權證為履行交換義務之方式，以等數量之BEP單位（需根據特定資本事件進行調整）或其現金等值（付款形式由本公司選擇決定）進行兌換。請參閱第10.B項「章程與 Articles of Association—BEPC交換權證—根據特定資本事件進行調整」。本公司與合夥關係目前預計將透過交付BEP單位而非現金來履行任何BEPC交換權證之兌換請求。因此，我們預期BEPC交換權證之市場價格將受BEP單位之市場價格及本公司集團整體營運表現之影響。然而，持有人在本公司與合夥關係之章程及適用法律下，持有BEPC交換權證與BEP單位之權利存在某些重大差異，例如持有人可請求將其BEPC交換權證兌換為等數量之BEP單位或其現金等值（付款形式由本公司選擇決定）之權利，以及本公司之贖回權。這些重大差異請參閱第10.B項「章程與 Articles of Association—比較BEPC交換權證持有人與BEP單位持有人之權利」。

此外，BEPC交換權證由Brookfield Wealth Solutions及公眾股東持有，而BEPC B類股份則由合夥關係持有。每張BEPC交換權證之股息預期將與每張BEP單位之分派同時且以相同金額每股支付。合夥關係持有BEPC B類股份之權利使其可根據董事會之宣告獲取股息。BEPC交換權證持有人在本公司股東會議上，每持有張BEPC交換權證可投一票，除非會議僅限於本公司其他特定類別或系列股份持有人投票。BEPC B類股份持有人將可投總數為BEPC交換權證投票數三倍之票數。除非BEPC章程另有明確規定或法律要求，BEPC交換權證持有人與BEPC B類股份持有人將共同投票，而非作為獨立類別。請參閱第10.B項「章程與 Articles of Association—BEPC交換權證」。
本公司目前之營運包含約13,396 MW之安裝水力、風力、太陽能、儲能及輔助容量，分佈於巴西、哥倫比亞、北美及歐洲。
作為合夥關係之控制子公司，我們策略之一為與Brookfield資助之基金、聯盟、合資企業及其他安排之機構投資者共同參與，以取得符合本公司資格之收購目標。在本公司集團業務中，我們利用其廣泛之營運經驗，以維持並提升資產價值、每年增加現金流，並與當地利益相關者建立良好關係。我們集團亦投資於永續解決方案企業，這些企業通常由處於轉型階段之資產類別組成，而我們集團之初始投資使其具備未來大規模減碳投資之潛力。
Brookfield Renewable目標為其擁有之可再生能源資產每年產生12%至15%之總回報，長期衡量。我們集團預計透過現有營運之現金流，加上透過資產基礎之升級與擴張投資以及收購來實現此回報。合夥關係根據對我們營運表現之評估來決定其分紅。我們集團使用FFO來評估營運表現，且可作為長期未來分紅成長之預測指標。

本公司受美國證券交易委員會（SEC）之資訊披露要求所規範。根據這些要求，本公司作為外國私人發行者，向SEC提交報告及其他資訊。SEC維護一個網站，包含本公司之報告、股東通函及資訊聲明等資訊。該網站位於http://www.sec.gov。類似資訊也可在本公司網站上找到，位於https://bep.brook、field.com/bepc。除了仔細審閱本文件中所披露資訊外，股東被強烈建議仔細審閱合夥關係之定期報告。合夥關係需向SEC提交報告，包括Form 20-F年度報告及其他資訊。合夥關係之SEC文件可從上述網站公開取得。已向加拿大證券主管機關提交之文件副本可於www.sedarplus.ca取得。有關合夥關係之資訊，包括其SEC文件，亦可在其網站上找到，位於https://bep.brookfield.com。本公司或合夥關係網站上或透過該網站取得之資訊並非本Form 20-F年度報告之一部分。請參閱第10.H項「公開文件」。
2020年7月30日，合夥關係完成向於2020年7月27日登記之BEP單位持有人發放BEPC交換權證之特別分紅。在完成特別分紅前，本公司已從合夥關係之部分子公司取得業務（如 herein 所定義），除外為巴西及哥倫比亞之10%權益，該權益仍由合夥關係持有。合夥關係在特別分紅前直接及間接控制該業務，並在特別分紅後繼續透過其在本公司之權益控制該業務。請參閱第5.A項「營運成果—權益持續性」。

於 2020 年 7 月 31 日，Brookfield Renewable 完成 TerraForm Power 收購，根據此交易，Brookfield Renewable 收購了所有公開發行的 TerraForm Power 股票，代表 TerraForm Power 38% 的權益。根據 TerraForm Power 收購，每持有 1 張公開發行的 TerraForm Power 股票之持有人，可取得 0.47625 張 BEPC 可轉換股票或 BEP 單元。此 TerraForm Power 收購是以 55,552,862 張 BEPC 可轉換股票及 6,051,704 張 BEP 單元為對價，於拆股後計算。

同時完成 TerraForm Power 收購，本公司與合夥企業及 Brookfield 某些間接子公司簽訂投票協議，將其在 TerraForm Power 所持股票的投票權轉讓予本公司。因此，本公司控制並合併 TerraForm Power。將 TerraForm Power 控制權轉讓予本公司被視為共同控制實體間的交易，其價值基於 Brookfield 在 TerraForm Power 的帳面價值計算。TerraForm Power 未被本公司擁有之部分，將於 2017 年 10 月 17 日回溯列為本公司之非控制性權益，並適用於 TerraForm Power 過去所有在共同控制下之歷史期間。

於 2024 年 12 月 24 日，BEPC 透過加拿大證券交易委員會（BCBCA）核准之安排計劃（"安排"）完成重組。根據此安排（i）除 Brookfield 以外之 Old BRHC 可轉換股票持有人，按一對一比例換取 BEPC 可轉換股票；（ii）Brookfield 將其 Old BRHC 可轉換次級投票股票換取 BEPC 可轉換股票，按一對一比例進行；（iii）Old BRHC 可轉換股票從市場除牌；（iv）BEPC 可轉換股票於紐約證券交易所（NYSE）及多倫多證券交易所（TSX）上市。此安排之目的為使 Brookfield Renewable 維持其業務結構之好處，同時應對加拿大所得稅法（加拿大）預期修正案，若未採取行動，將導致 BEPC 面臨額外成本。
於 2025 年 3 月，Brookfield Renewable 發行 C$450 百萬之 Series 19 中期票據（綠色債券），利率為固定 4.542%。Series 19 中期票據由 BEP 及其某些子公司 fully and unconditionally 保證。
於 2025 年 4 月，Brookfield Renewable 與機構夥伴共同完成印度 1,004 MW 風力與太陽能資產組合之出售，分階段進行，總計約 $188 百萬（淨收入約 $52 百萬至 Brookfield Renewable）。
於 2025 年 6 月，Brookfield Renewable 發行 C$250 百萬之固定利率轉固定利率重設利率綠色次級混合票據，初始固定利率為 5.373%。此混合票據由 BEP 及其某些子公司 fully and unconditionally 保證。

BEPC 是一家加拿大公司，於 2024 年 10 月 3 日根據不列顛哥倫比亞省法律註冊成立。本公司由 Brookfield Renewable 組建，作為一種替代投資工具，讓投資者偏好透過公司結構擁有證券。雖然我們的業務主要位於美國、巴西、哥倫比亞和歐洲，但股東在經濟層面上將會對 BEP 營運的所有地區有 exposures。這是因為 BEPC 交易所附屬的 Class A 可轉換次級投票股（"BEPC 可轉換股"）的特性，使得 BEPC 有選擇以現金或非投票有限合夥單位（"LP 單位"）來回應轉換請求的權利。

本公司之 BEPC 可轉換股結構的目的是使其在經濟上等同於 LP 單位。我們相信經濟等同是透過 BEPC 可轉換股與 LP 單位相同的股息與分派，以及每張 BEPC 可轉換股在持有人選擇下可隨時轉換為一單位 LP 單位來實現。基於經濟等同，我們預期 BEPC 可轉換股的市場價格將會受到 LP 單位市場價格以及本公司與 Brookfield Renewable 綜合營運表現的顯著影響。除了仔細審閱本文件所披露的資訊外，股東也應強烈建議仔細審閱合夥公司的定期報告。合夥公司必須提交報告，包括年度報告 Form 20-F，以及其他資訊至美國證券交易委員會（"SEC"）。合夥公司的 SEC 檔案可透過 SEC 網站 https://www.sec.gov 公開取得。已提交加拿大證券主管機關的文件可透過 https://www.sedarplus.ca 取得。有關合夥公司的資訊，包括其 SEC 檔案，也可在該公司的網站 https://bep.brookfield.com 查閱。在 https://bep.brookfield.com 找到的資訊或可透過此網站存取的資訊，並未納入本 MD&A 並不構成本 MD&A 的一部分。

本公司、Brookfield Renewable Holdings Corporation（"BRHC"）、我們的子公司與 Brookfield Renewable（合稱我們的 "集團"），目標是對我們所擁有的可再生能源資產，每年產生 12% 到 15% 的總回報，以長期為衡量標準。我們的集團預計透過營運現金流以及對資產基礎的升級與擴張投資，以及收購與資本循環計畫來達成此回報。Brookfield Renewable 會根據其營運表現評估來決定其分派。我們的集團使用 Funds From Operations（"FFO"）來評估營運表現，這可以作為長期未來分派成長的參考指標。如需更多細節，請參閱本 MD&A 的 "績效揭露" 章節。

2024 年 12 月 24 日，合夥公司、BRHC 與本公司完成了安排（"安排"），根據此安排，1505127 B.C. Ltd.（後改名為 Brookfield Renewable Corporation）成為前 BEPC 的 "繼承發行者"（根據 NI 44-101 定義），前 BEPC 改名為 Brookfield Renewable Holdings Corporation，且 BRHC 的 Class A 可轉換次級投票股被除牌。此安排的目的是讓 BEPC 維持其業務結構的優勢，同時應對加拿大所得稅法（加拿大）預期的修正案，若不採取行動，可能會導致公司產生額外成本。與此安排相關的事項包括（i）除了 Brookfield 以外的 BRHC Class A 可轉換次級投票股持有人，以一對一的比例換取 BEPC 可轉換股；（ii）Brookfield 以一對一的比例將其 BRHC Class A 可轉換次級投票股換取 Class A.2 可轉換股；（iii）BRHC 的 Class A 可轉換次級投票股被除牌；（iv）BEPC 的可轉換股在紐約證券交易所（NYSE）與多倫多證券交易所（TSX）上市；（v）合夥公司將 55 個 BRHC Class B 股換取給 BEPC，以換取 55 個 BEPC Class B 股；（vi）合夥公司發行 43,605 個 BEPC Class B 股，以換取 1 百萬美元。Class A.2 可轉換股可由 Brookfield 交換為 BEPC 可轉換股（受制於一個所有權上限，限制 Brookfield 交換 Class A.2 可轉換股，使得 Brookfield 交換後不致擁有 BEPC 所發行及流通股份總公平市價價值的 9.5% 或更多）或 LP 單位，比例為一對一。
Class A.2 可轉換股可由 Brookfield 交換為 BEPC 可轉換股（受制於一個所有權上限，限制 Brookfield 交換 Class A.2 可轉換股，使得 Brookfield 交換後不致擁有 BEPC 所發行及流通股份總公平市價價值的 9.5% 或更多）或 LP 單位，比例為一對一。
